title: North Country Canoe Outfitters
specs: Trips in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness and Quetico Provincial Park
Wilderness canoe camping with portaging and fishing opportunities
Scenic lakes, forests, wildlife including moose, eagles, loons, and wolves
Youth rate for 17 and under (through 21 with current high school or college ID)
Passports required for trips entering Canada
CANPAS – RABC permit required for adults entering Canada
Participants must sign Risk Agreement form before trip
Physical conditioning and canoeing ability required; portaging unimproved trails
Jungle boots required for High Adventure trips
Group sizes typically 6 to 9 people per travel group

Staff briefing on equipment use, menu review, portaging skills

blurb: Guests experience wilderness canoe camping trips in the Boundary Waters Canoe Area Wilderness (BWCA) and Quetico Provincial Park. Trips range from 3 to 14 days with options for complete or partial outfitting. The outfitter provides gear, guides, and planning assistance tailored to group ability and goals.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit of $100 per person at reservation · Cash discount 3% on final invoice · Maximum group size 9 people together at any time per park regulations · Multiple discounts allowed up to $125 maximum deduction per individual · Reservation fees and camping fee deposits required for permits · Changes to permit dates require securing new permits; deposits remain valid · Lakeside canoe base near Ely, Minnesota
